title: Sebi examining position limits for non-agri contracts to boost liquidity
description: Sebi is actively investigating position limits for non-agricultural contracts to improve market liquidity and depth. Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey has highlighted the importance of phased physical settlement for agricultural commodities. The organization is focused on addressing structural issues and increasing technology integration in commodity markets. Furthermore, Sebi plans to expand its educational outreach through Project Jagrook to better inform market participants.

title: Dalal Street Week Ahead: Oversold Nifty may rebound as volatility stays high

This is the first breach of this long-term average since March 2020 and makes the 22,600 area particularly important over the coming days.

title: Cube Highways Trust secures Rs.1,150 crore through AAA-rated NCDs

Major institutional players, Axis Bank Limited and ICICI Bank Limited, were pivotal investors in this transaction. The proceeds will facilitate debt refinancing and support ongoing capital projects, as part of an ambitious financing initiative targeting Rs. 4,500 crore.

title: Sebi to soon issue framework on Closing Auction Session; receives over 3,500 comments

The regulator reviewed comments on its consultation paper about market timings and settlement methodology. Sebi intends to address specific issues related to derivatives settlement prices after consultations. Regulatory measures for corporate bond derivatives are also being developed to promote market growth.
